HiddenVideo.title: HiddenVideo
HiddenVideo.description: A video ID that should be hidden from the UI.

hiddenBy.description: The email of the admin who hid the video.

DeletedVideo.title: DeletedVideo
DeletedVideo.description: A video ID that has been permanently deleted from the app view.

deletedBy.description: The email of the admin who deleted the video.

MyList.title: MyList
MyList.description: A video ID that a user has added to their personal list.

userId.description: The ID of the user who added the video.

addedAt.description: When the video was added to the list.

VideoStats.title: VideoStats
VideoStats.description: Statistics for a video, such as view count.

viewCount.description: The number of times the video has been played.

lastViewedAt.description: When the video was last viewed.

RecommendedVideo.title: RecommendedVideo
RecommendedVideo.description: A video ID that has been recommended by the admin for all users.

addedBy.description: The email of the admin who added the recommendation.

MovieDetail.title: MovieDetail
MovieDetail.description: Cached movie information from Gemini API.

/hiddenVideos/{videoId}.description: Collection of video IDs to be hidden from the public view.

/deletedVideos/{videoId}.description: Collection of video IDs that are permanently deleted from the app.

/recommendedVideos/{videoId}.description: Collection of video IDs recommended by the admin for all users.

/movieDetails/{videoId}.description: Cached movie information for all users.

/users/{userId}/myList/{videoId}.description: Personal list of videos for a user.

/videoStats/{videoId}.description: Collection of video statistics, used for popularity tracking.
